overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the executive session topic was properly raised to schedule a future discussion, and no evidence showed a quorum coordinated the vote outside a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint said a discipline topic raised by motion at the May 23, 2011 meeting for a later executive session was not noticed in advance.
allegations.key_passage: Furthermore, even if the topic had been anticipated, it was appropriate for a Board member raise the topic for the purpose of scheduling a future discussion when the topic could be including in a meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint said three members knew of the executive session topic before the open meeting, suggesting a quorum discussed it outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Board denies this and we have uncovered no evidence to suggest that the quorum coordinated the vote.
